description: Auto-nudges the model to file EPLUS tool failures via this plugin's report_issue tool. One PostToolUseFailure wiring using the polyglot shell-form pattern: report-tool-failure.ps1 runs on Windows hosts (where hooks execute in Cowork Chat), report-tool-failure.sh on POSIX surfaces, each no-ops on the other's platform, trailing `exit 0` valid in every routed shell. Context-only (additionalContext); never blocks a tool call.
